items.title: Marshall Football Falls To Georgia Southern, 49-13
items.summary: Marshall Football dropped a 49-13 contest at Georgia Southern in front of a Homecoming crowd of 24,023 fans at Allen E. Paulson Stadium on Saturday.

items.title: Marshall Football Battles Georgia Southern At 3:30 p.m. On Saturday
items.summary: Marshall Football looks for its third straight win on Saturday when the team travels to take on Georgia Southern in a 3:30 p.m. contest that will be shown on ESPN+ from Paulson Stadium in Statesboro, Ga.

items.title: Marshall RB Judah Price Named 2026 Burlsworth Trophy Nominee
items.summary: Marshall redshirt sophomore running back Judah Price was named as one of 65 nominees for the 2026 Burlsworth Trophy, the trophy's selection committee announced on Tuesday.

items.title: Marshall Kicker Jorge Diaz Nicolas Named To Lou Groza Award ‘Stars of the Week’
items.summary: Marshall redshirt freshman kicker Jorge Diaz Nicolas was named to the Lou Groza Award's 'Stars of the Week' list on Tuesday afternoon. Diaz Nicolas became the first player in Marshall history with five field goals in a game when he went a perfect 5-for-5 in the Herd's 36-23 win over Old Dominion.

items.title: Marshall Football’s ‘75’ Game Vs. App State Set For 6 p.m.
items.summary: Marshall Football's Nov. 14 contest against App State will be a 6 p.m. kickoff at Joan C. Edwards Stadium and be shown on ESPN+, it was announced on Monday. The announcement at the 12-day window comes as part of the television contract between the Sun Belt Conference and ESPN.

items.title: Marshall Football Rolls Past Old Dominion, 36-23
items.summary: Marshall kicker Jorge Diaz Nicolas had a Marshall-record five field goals and Xayvion Turner-Bradshaw scored on a 100-yard Kick-Six to end the first half in a wild 36-23 victory at S.B. Ballard Stadium in Norfolk, Va., on Saturday.

items.title: Marshall Football Travels To ODU At 1 p.m. On Saturday
items.summary: Marshall Football hits the road for the first of two straight road contests on Saturday, traveling to Norfolk, Va., for a 1 p.m. matchup against Old Dominion at S.B. Ballard Stadium. The game will be shown on ESPN+ and is ODU's Homecoming for 2026.

items.title: Marshall Football’s Nov. 7 Game At Ga. Southern Set For 3:30 p.m.
items.summary: Marshall Football's Nov. 7 contest at Georgia Southern will be a 3:30 p.m. kickoff from Paulson Stadium in Statesboro, Ga., and shown on ESPN+, it was announced on Monday. The announcement at the 12-day window comes as part of the television contract between the Sun Belt Conference and ESPN.

items.title: Marshall Football Grinds Past South Alabama, 20-13
items.summary: Marshall running back Judah Price scored on a 4-yard run with 1:49 left in the game as the Thundering Herd earned a 20-13 victory over South Alabama in front of 21,904 fans and a national TV audience on Tuesday night.

items.title: Marshall Football’s Oct. 31 Game At ODU Set For 1 p.m.
items.summary: Marshall Football's Oct. 31 contest at Old Dominion will be a 1 p.m. kickoff shown on ESPN+ from S.B. Ballard Stadium in Norfolk, Va. The announcement was made in conjunction with the Sun Belt Conference and ESPN through the network's 12-day broadcast window.
